definitions.articularis genu muscle: A small skeletal muscle organ of the anterior thigh, lying deep to the vastus intermedius, that arises from the anterior surface of the distal shaft of the femur and inserts onto the proximal wall of the suprapatellar bursa and the synovial membrane of the knee joint, where it retracts the bursa superiorly during knee extension.
